trap-superlative.evidence: The 'Empirical confirmation' section's two headline numbers do not reconcile with the chapter's own witness, and one of them contradicts a sibling block outright. 'The N=2 step (Kashiwara b^2 alone) gives a residual of +1.25 ppm ... The N=3 step (structural c_3 = -2) yields +0.011 ppm ... a 112x tightening.' The internal ratio is fine (1.25/0.011 = 114, quoted as 112). But prop:q-beta-c-2-eq-neg-one-structural states the N=2 residual as 5.6 ppm, and its witness (qbeta-symbolic-chain-alpha-b.witness.json) records eps_N0 = 1681.9, eps_N1 = 78.156, eps_N2 = 5.60699 ppm - I reproduced all three independently at 40 dps. No step of the canonical chain gives 1.25 ppm, and 5.6 vs 1.25 is a factor of 4.5 on the same quantity. The N=3 figure is also stale in the same direction: 0.011 ppm = 11 ppb belongs to the pre-2026-05-28 muon-anchored era (compare AGENTS.md, which records the current Q_beta miss as 1279 ppb and the Habiro-exact 5.7 ppb result as explicitly not refreshed since the proton re-pin).
